# X08 cycle 2, boot 3 on g1: the cycle 1 data volume (internal virtio disk)
# again on the system disk that made it, and a blank USB mass storage disk,
# which the guest sees as external. Format the USB disk APFS and look at
# it. Then add a passphrase-protected volume to the cycle 1 container, as a
# second candidate. Throwaway.
set -u
diskutil list
echo "-- cycle 1 volume on its own system disk:"
diskutil info WBData | grep -E 'Device Identifier|Mounted|Mount Point|Owners'
mount | grep -i wbdata || { diskutil mount WBData 2>&1; mount | grep -i wbdata; }
usb=""
for d in disk0 disk1 disk2 disk3 disk4 disk5 disk6 disk7; do
  info=$(diskutil info $d 2>/dev/null) || continue
  echo "$info" | grep -q 'Protocol: *USB' || continue
  echo "$info" | grep -q 'Content (IOContent): *None' && usb=$d
done
echo "usb disk: ${usb:-none}"
[ -n "$usb" ] || exit 1
diskutil info $usb | grep -E 'Media Name|Protocol|Device Location|Removable|Ejectable|Disk Size|Solid'
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
diskutil eraseDisk APFS WBHomes GPT $usb
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME format $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
diskutil info WBHomes | grep -E 'Device Identifier|Mount Point|Owners|Volume UUID|Device Location|Removable|FileVault|Encrypt'
diskutil apfs list | grep -B2 -A10 'WBHomes' | grep -E 'Name|FileVault|Encrypt|Container'

echo "-- passphrase volume in the cycle 1 container:"
c=$(diskutil info WBData | awk -F: '/APFS Container:/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
diskutil apfs addVolume "$c" APFS WBPass -passphrase x08-pass 2>&1 | tail -3
diskutil info WBPass | grep -E 'Device Identifier|Mount Point|FileVault|Encrypt|Locked'
diskutil apfs listCryptoUsers WBPass 2>&1
echo "on the passphrase volume" > /Volumes/WBPass/marker && cat /Volumes/WBPass/marker

  dscl . -create /Groups/$n PrimaryGroupID $gid
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n RealName "x08 $n"

# X08 cycle 2: the host state wb-hostd would keep per project user, used to
# create the users on g1 (boot 3) and recreate them on g2 (boot 4). The
# homes are on the passphrase volume WBPass: the USB volume WBHomes is
# refused by TCC (c2-02, c2-03). PASS is the volume passphrase the host
# would keep and hand to wb-guestd at each boot.
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbq1 611 611 FEB034B1-B3D0-45A2-B4CB-20E64337C168 F7669BC6-8BED-4835-853F-3FAB79B65A66
wbq2 612 612 9BDC4F74-9188-4C55-A2F3-AB9337A66081 0D1715CB-07CE-4C87-B482-0C0356FD884C
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhomes
H=$HOMES U1=wbq1 U2=wbq2 VOLNAME=WBPass PASS=x08-pass
# X08: the behavior checks, run on every boot after the users exist.
# $H, $U1 and $U2 come from the host-state header (defaults: cycle 1).
# Throwaway.
set -u
H=${H:-/Volumes/wbhomes}; U1=${U1:-wbp1}; U2=${U2:-wbp2}
export H U1 U2
echo "mount: $(mount | grep " $H " || echo NOT MOUNTED)"
for n in $U1 $U2; do
  echo "== $n: $(id $n 2>&1)"
  echo "   GeneratedUID $(dsmemberutil getuuid -U $n 2>&1)"
  sudo -u $n -H /bin/sh -c '
    n=$(id -un); cd "$HOME" || { echo "cd home failed"; exit 1; }
    link=$(echo "$HOME/sessions/s1" | sed "s/[^A-Za-z0-9]/-/g")
    echo "  HOME=$HOME"
    echo "  claude settings: $(cat .claude/settings.json 2>&1)"
    echo "  claude.json: $(cat .claude.json 2>&1 | cut -c1-80)"
    echo "  conversation via the session link: $(cat .claude/projects/$link/c1.jsonl 2>&1)"
    echo "  write in home: $( (echo x > w-test) 2>&1 && echo ok && rm -f w-test)"
    echo "  write in .claude: $( (echo x > .claude/w-test) 2>&1 && echo ok && rm -f .claude/w-test)"
    echo "  append to acl-deny (ACL denies the user): $( (echo x >> acl-deny) 2>/dev/null && echo ALLOWED || echo refused)"
    echo "  write m400: $( (echo x >> m400) 2>/dev/null && echo ALLOWED || echo refused)"
    echo "  rm uchg-file: $(rm -f uchg-file 2>/dev/null; [ -e uchg-file ] && echo refused || echo REMOVED)"
    echo "  run m755: $(./m755 2>&1)"
    kc="$HOME/Library/Keychains/x08.keychain-db"
    echo "  keychain unlock: $(security unlock-keychain -p "kc-$n" "$kc" 2>&1 && echo ok)"
    echo "  keychain item: $(security find-generic-password -s x08-item -w "$kc" 2>&1)"
    echo "  keychain new item: $(security add-generic-password -U -a "$n" -s x08-item2 -w new "$kc" 2>&1 && echo ok)"
    echo "  login keychain: $(security login-keychain 2>&1)"
  ' 2>&1
done
echo "== cross-user"
sudo -u $U2 env H=$H U1=$U1 U2=$U2 /bin/sh -c '
  echo "  $U2 ls $U1 home: $(ls $H/$U1 2>&1 | head -1)"
  echo "  $U2 read $U1 .claude.json: $(cat $H/$U1/.claude.json 2>&1 | head -1)"
  echo "  $U2 read $U1 keychain: $(head -c 4 $H/$U1/Library/Keychains/x08.keychain-db 2>&1 | head -1)"
  echo "  $U2 write in data volume root: $( (echo x > $H/x) 2>&1 | head -1)"' 2>&1
sudo -u $U1 env H=$H U1=$U1 U2=$U2 /bin/sh -c '
  echo "  $U1 ls $U2 home: $(ls $H/$U2 2>&1 | head -1)"
  echo "  $U1 run $U2 suid-euid: $($H/$U2/suid-euid 2>&1 | head -1)"' 2>&1
echo "== setuid binary, as $U2"
ls -l $H/$U2/suid-euid
sudo -u $U2 env H=$H U1=$U1 U2=$U2 /bin/sh -c 'echo "  euid via suid-euid: $($H/$U2/suid-euid)"' 2>&1
true
